name: 45638 · Ironton, OH
findings: ZIP 45638 (Ironton) has 71 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45638 (Ironton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 45638 (Ironton) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
